fields.name: Weight Management
fields.description: Sustainable, evidence-based plans tailored to your routine, food preferences, and goals. No crash diets, no banned-food lists — just a steady, livable approach to reaching and maintaining a healthy weight.
fields.short_description: Sustainable plans built around your life — no crash diets.

fields.name: Clinical Nutrition
fields.description: Personalised medical-nutrition therapy for diabetes, PCOS, hypertension, thyroid disorders, and kidney disease. Plans built around your lab work and Pakistani eating habits.
fields.short_description: Diabetes, PCOS, hypertension, thyroid, kidney disease.

fields.name: Prenatal & Postnatal Nutrition
fields.description: Trimester-specific guidance during pregnancy, plus postpartum recovery and breastfeeding nutrition support — nourishment for you and your baby.

fields.name: Sports & Performance Nutrition
fields.description: Macro planning, pre/post-workout fueling, hydration and recovery strategies for athletes, gym-goers, and active professionals.
fields.short_description: Macro planning, fueling, and recovery for athletes.

fields.name: Paediatric Nutrition
fields.description: Growth-assessment-led plans for children and adolescents — picky eating, weight concerns, anaemia, and balanced school-going routines.
fields.short_description: Children & adolescents — growth, picky eating, anaemia.

fields.name: Lab Report Interpretation
fields.description: Send in your most recent blood panel — we'll review it together and translate it into a nutrition intervention you can actually follow.
fields.short_description: Blood-panel review + a nutrition plan you can follow.

fields.name: General Diet Assessment
fields.description: A one-time review of what you currently eat and how you live, with clear, prioritised recommendations — ideal if you just want a credible second opinion.
